authoring: Original Protocodus sound design from init; no factory derivation

voices.name: BASS - Low Gravity
voices.description: Round centered sub with a brief soft FM strike and a slowly fading body. No chorus keeps the bottom focused.

performance.velocity: Harder notes add a small rounded attack; the body stays predominantly sine.
performance.mod_wheel: Adds a subtle slow pitch shimmer, leaving the centered low end intact.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.

voices.name: BASS - Rubber Relay
voices.description: A two-to-one FM attack contracts into a rounded, lightly saturated bass body for syncopated short notes.

performance.velocity: Velocity opens the rubbery strike considerably while keeping the tail warmer.
performance.mod_wheel: Adds restrained vibrato for held accents.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.

voices.name: BASS - Split Current
voices.description: Slightly offset operator tuning and feedback make a moving Reese-like spectrum; a shallow stereo delay widens its edge.

performance.velocity: Harder playing adds more metallic motion without removing the sustained body.
performance.mod_wheel: Introduces gentle pitch movement; it does not change the FM ratio.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.

voices.name: BASS - Vowel Engine
voices.description: Three-to-one half-wave FM moves under a per-note amplitude LFO, producing a throaty rhythmic growl over a stable carrier.

performance.velocity: Velocity raises the growl intensity; softer hits expose more of the carrier.
performance.mod_wheel: Adds slow pitch wobble at the same rate as the growl movement.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.

voices.name: BASS - Alloy Teeth
voices.description: A seven-to-one modulator puts a hard metallic edge above a short, solid bass envelope.

performance.velocity: Soft hits are rounded; hard hits reveal the upper metallic strike.
performance.mod_wheel: Adds a small pitch flutter for accent notes.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.

voices.name: BASS - Acid Fuse
voices.description: Squared-sine operators and strong feedback produce a rasping opening that quickly closes into a narrow pulsing body.

performance.velocity: High velocity brightens the opening rasp; the envelope closes without a filter sweep.
performance.mod_wheel: Adds a narrow fast vibrato; pitch bend gives the larger slides.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.

voices.name: BASS - Pulse Stencil
voices.description: Half-squared FM is pulsed by a four-hertz modulator-only LFO, while the low carrier remains continuously present.

performance.velocity: Velocity adds bite to each timbral pulse rather than muting the bass between pulses.
performance.mod_wheel: Adds a modest four-hertz pitch wobble to the pulsing texture.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.

voices.name: BASS - Hollow Stack
voices.description: A clean three-to-one sine pair gives an odd-harmonic hollow character with a rounded onset and compact release.

performance.velocity: Velocity moves the tone from almost pure to hollow and woody.
performance.mod_wheel: Adds gentle vibrato for the ends of longer phrases.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.

voices.name: BASS - Undergrid
voices.description: A half-rate modulator creates a subharmonic beneath the carrier; its bright attack falls away into a low rubbery tail.

performance.velocity: Harder hits emphasize the subharmonic growl; play an octave above a conventional sub line.
performance.mod_wheel: Adds mild pitch motion without changing the half-rate relationship.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.

voices.name: BASS - Wire Tension
voices.description: An offset coarse-tuned modulator leaves an inharmonic wire-like edge around a centered carrier; the edge decays before the body.

performance.velocity: Low velocity gives a clean body; higher velocity reveals the inharmonic attack.
performance.mod_wheel: Adds restrained vibrato suitable for single-note accents.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.

voices.name: BASS - Pluck Circuit
voices.description: A fast three-to-one FM pluck with a sustained low residual, voiced for repeated sixteenth-note bass patterns.

performance.velocity: Velocity strongly controls the pluck brightness and moderately controls level.
performance.mod_wheel: Adds vibrato mainly to held residual notes; short plucks stay focused.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.

voices.name: BASS - Slow Crush
voices.description: Feedback-rich half-wave FM opens over the first few tens of milliseconds, then moves slowly under a timbral LFO.

performance.velocity: Velocity changes how far the crushed texture opens after the initial low onset.
performance.mod_wheel: Adds slow pitch motion aligned with the timbral LFO.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.

voices.name: DONK - Concrete Knock
voices.description: A classic short two-to-one FM knock: bright opening, rapidly falling index and a round percussive carrier.

performance.velocity: Harder hits increase the initial knock; the body remains short at every velocity.
performance.mod_wheel: Adds a subtle pitch quiver during the decay.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.

voices.name: DONK - Hollow Impact
voices.description: A three-to-one FM thud with a hollow middle and a tighter carrier envelope than Concrete Knock.

performance.velocity: Velocity adds a woody ring to the front of the hit.
performance.mod_wheel: Introduces very small pitch movement; the short body remains percussive.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.

voices.name: DONK - Glass Hammer
voices.description: A seven-to-one FM flash falls quickly into a squared-sine body, giving a glassy top without a long bell tail.

performance.velocity: Higher velocity adds glass to the attack; soft notes are rounder and darker.
performance.mod_wheel: Adds a light vibrato to the remaining glassy body.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.

voices.name: DONK - Timber Trigger
voices.description: A half-sine modulator gives a woody asymmetric knock with a softer, rounded decay after the first impact.

performance.velocity: Velocity sharpens the wooden impact while leaving the later body mellow.
performance.mod_wheel: Adds a slight vibrato for pitched percussion fills.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.

voices.name: DONK - Sub Mallet
voices.description: A half-rate carrier makes a low octave mallet with a brief brighter strike. Play higher than the other donks for a comparable bass register.

performance.velocity: Hard hits emphasize the mallet strike; soft hits become a low rounded pulse.
performance.mod_wheel: Adds very gentle pitch movement to the lower octave.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.

voices.name: DONK - Laser Knuckle
voices.description: A coarse-detuned high-ratio strike collapses into a clean short carrier, creating a laser-like metallic click without a pitch envelope.

performance.velocity: Velocity exposes the inharmonic laser edge; lower values leave a cleaner donk.
performance.mod_wheel: Adds a controlled pitch quiver to the brief body.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.

voices.name: DONK - Rebound
voices.description: Four-to-one FM drops quickly to a lower index that persists beneath a two-stage carrier decay, giving a knock followed by a rounded after-ring.

performance.velocity: Velocity changes both the knock and the residual FM ring.
performance.mod_wheel: Adds restrained vibrato to the after-ring.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.

voices.name: DONK - Scrap Bounce
voices.description: Five-to-one half-squared feedback FM produces a gritty top that decays faster than its compact squared-sine bass body.

performance.velocity: Hard hits add a rough metallic front; softer playing makes the body more rounded.
performance.mod_wheel: Adds a light pitch flutter for accent hits.
performance.pitch_bend: Two semitones either way; use short bends between notes.
